def overlap(left, right):
    """Inputs are integer lists."""
    members = set(right)
    return [value for value in left if value in members]

limitations: Static inspection only; no execution environment or SAST tools available.
No benchmarks executed; theoretical time complexity is O(N + M) and space complexity is O(M).
No style configuration or linter was supplied.

findings.summary: There are no tests verifying behavior when left and right have disjoint elements or when non-empty inputs result in an empty list.
findings.suggested_action: Add a unit test covering disjoint inputs, e.g., overlap([1, 3], [2, 4]) == [].
